name: sinkhole-domain-onboard
description: G'-prime Workflow D: Cloudflare DNS + listener provisioning when sinkhole opportunity is detected. Adds DNS record pointing to sinkhole listener host. Operator-confirmed. Tracking: OPS-573.

triggers.name: Sinkhole Opportunity Webhook
triggers.label: Sinkhole domain opportunity trigger
triggers.description: Triggered manually or by MISP detection when a domain sinkhole opportunity is identified. Fields: domain, sinkhole_ip, rationale.

actions.name: Telegram confirm: sinkhole domain
actions.label: Request operator confirmation before DNS change

parameters.name: message
parameters.value:
SINKHOLE REQUEST
Domain: $exec.body.domain
Sinkhole IP: $exec.body.sinkhole_ip
Rationale: $exec.body.rationale

Reply YES to provision Cloudflare DNS + listener, NO to abort.

actions.name: Create Cloudflare DNS record
actions.label: Add A record pointing domain to sinkhole IP

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: INSERT INTO attacker_intel.sinkhole_domains (domain, sinkhole_ip, cloudflare_record_id, rationale, provisioned_at) VALUES ('$exec.body.domain', '$exec.body.sinkhole_ip', '$cloudflare-create-dns.result.id', '$exec.body.rationale', NOW());

parameters.name: message
parameters.value:
SINKHOLE PROVISIONED
Domain: $exec.body.domain -> $exec.body.sinkhole_ip
Cloudflare record: $cloudflare-create-dns.result.id
Monitor traffic to sinkhole listener.
